checkpoint_finding.declared_training_corpus: Only registered outer-training donor-state ATAC peaks and matched nonpeaks from permitted genomic blocks
checkpoint_finding.source_revision_warning: The code revision postdates every named GEO source, but it contains no admitted learned biological checkpoint. Project-model exposure is governed by immutable training manifests and chronology, not the source-code date alone.

interpretation: deltaSVM is a strong assay-native regulatory-activity baseline when trained on biologically appropriate outer-training ATAC. Its principal leakage surface is project construction: donor pooling, peak calling, matched negatives, genomic groups, k-mer-table generation, sign handling, and any MPRA transform. GSE289173 labels and QTL outcomes remain unexposed, but the score is still not a target-gene or signed expression-effect prediction.
known_incidents_and_biases: Historical website weights and the historical deltasvm.pl implementation are not immutable parts of the selected source and are excluded.
The native delta is REF minus ALT. Most project sequence comparators report ALT minus REF, so an unnoticed sign flip would reverse biological interpretation.
deltaSVM and direct gkm-SVM share the same trained LS-GKM weights and cannot be counted as independent model or evidence families.
The source FASTA parser can silently retain only the first 2047 bases after warning; project validation must reject this path.
LS-GKM -r affects only its internal cross-validation shuffle. It does not seed ordinary model fitting or project negative matching.
A positive or negative accessibility vocabulary change does not identify the affected gene and need not share the sign of an eQTL when an element is repressive.
Cell-state specificity depends on the ATAC substrate and annotation; a missing or underpowered state cannot be replaced with the nearest available lineage.
remaining_blockers: Build the exact source only in an approved CPU SLURM runtime; freeze compiler, libc, zlib, command line, environment, and binary SHA-256, then pass model-save/load, gzip, deterministic-score, thread-tolerance, and malformed-input probes.
Activate GSE296875 only after donor/barcode/well, fragment, reference, cell-state, peak, QC, missingness, pathology, and rights authorities pass.
Freeze every donor/genomic fold, training-fold peak universe, one-to-one matched background roster, 300-bp sequence hash, seed-specific row order, model hash, and 11-mer-table hash.
Implement the clean-room SNP-only 21-bp overlapping-k-mer wrapper and pass a hand-calculated REF-minus-ALT, canonical ALT-minus-REF, reverse-complement, REF-match, boundary, and N-rejection fixture.
Activate GSE281364 only after oligo/allele/barcode/count/context/replicate joins and rights pass; keep any fitted assay-native transform out of fold and prohibit an eQTL-specific head.
Before sealed inference, freeze whether the raw or any cross-fitted MPRA-transformed activity delta enters retrieval, and keep every target-gene linker as a separately named component.
